rationale: The Court is most likely to affirm on the threshold ground that an ad-supported sports news site with incidental clips is not “engaged in the business” of renting, selling, or delivering “prerecorded video cassette tapes or similar audiovisual materials,” avoiding any need to resolve the harder “consumer/subscriber” question. Dissents are likely to press a technology-neutral reading of “delivery/similar audiovisual materials” and warn against an atextual narrowing that creates a modern privacy gap.
